verdict.rationale: The Agent API documents profiles as a "reusable, versioned configuration that you save and manage," which covers versioning of user-defined agent configurations. Effort/preset version pinning lets you keep running an older vendor-released configuration, but that applies to Perplexity's presets, not the user's own automations. Tool-call approvals are a runtime review of individual calls, not review of automation changes, so they earn no credit. missing for 10: documented review/diff workflow for profile changes, explicit rollback to a prior profile version, depth of profile version history, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations

citations.quote: A profile is a reusable, versioned configuration that you save and manage.
call an effort level with a version (e.g., `effort="fast@2026-10-16.0"`) to keep running one released configuration after the effort level moves on.
